Title: Code of Samiel and Loving Agony

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
When a Salubri antitribu burns a ready vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat with Loviing Agony does he or she untaps after the end of the minion phase via Code of Samiel?

Loving Agony
Type: Combat
Requires: Valeren/Animalism
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable at close range.
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[val] Strike: combat ends and the opposing minion takes 1 damage.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this vampire may burn 1 blood to untap before combat ends.

Code of Samiel
Type: Master
Requires: Salubri antitribu
Cost: 2 pool
Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your untap phase, a Salubri antitribu you control gains 1 blood. When a Salubri antitribu burns a ready vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat or as a  action, he or she untaps after the end of the minion phase. Burn option

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
> Code of Samiel
> Type: Master
> Requires: Salubri antitribu
> Cost: 2 pool
> Unique master.
> Put this card in play. During your untap phase, a Salubri antitribu you control gains 1 blood. When a Salubri antitribu burns a ready vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat or as a  action, he or she untaps after the end of the minion phase. Burn option
>
Hmm, interesting.

> burns a ready vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat or as a  action
>
Grammatically, the following meanings can be derived:
- Burns a ready vampire in combat.
- Sends a vampire to torpor in combat.
- Burns a ready vampire as a  action.
- Sends a vampire to torpor as a  action.

It looks like it requires an explicit  action to burn a ready vampire or send a vampire to torpor. Anything else would not trigger this part of the text.

The following cards would trigger it (provided !salubri can play it, might take some setting up)
- Barreness (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=2027)
- Community Justice (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1778)
- Rubicon (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1979)
- Set's Curse (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1837)
- Sixth Tradition: Destruction (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=264)
- Sleep of Reason (www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?lib=1363)

The following would not (examples, not complete):
- Diablerie: The target is not a ready vampire.
- Dismemberment of Osiris: It burns a vampire, but not a ready one.
- Horseshoes: Though it can torporise a vamp, it does not explicitly send one to torpor.
- Nosferatu Performance Art: If you turn your !salubri into a nosferatu to play this card, it's no longer a !salubri doing it

The Horseshoes case is very interesting, for that to work the wording of Code of Samiel had to be: "As a result of a  action" in which case it would also work for rushes, but still not for Loving Agony, since the torpor moment (if any) happens after the combat was resolved (which is also the absolute end of any action unless continued by card text ie. form of mist) and is thus not a result of an action or combat.

Soooo, I would say it's a wording mistake, but unless errata-ed, this seems to be how it works wording wise.

-1 Strength

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
Predator's Transformation is the only comparable card that has a "or as a  action" text (the "or" being the important component here).

Relevant text (Predator's Transformation):
>
> Only usable when this vampire burns a minion controlled by your prey, either in combat or as a  action.
>
]

There are many other cards with "as a  action" where the explicit action precursors the action type, which makes the template: {action description} as a {action type}.

Another point, if Horseshoes can trigger Code of Samiel, then any rush action can as well, but I let me avoid that discussion.

-1 Strength

I'd just like to point out that the action isn't necessarily over once combat is complete. After the opposing vampire is sent to torpor via Loving Agony, you can still play Action Modifiers like Freak Drive. If the action isn't over, and the opposing minion was sent to torpor, that would seem to meet the criterion on Code of Samiel. The fact that it's unclear and that so many of these unclear situations exist is yet another great argument for a VTES reboot.
